title: ELVES Mori AeroX official component weights and construction
notes: Technical section gives 428 g fork excluding axle; 188/220 g seatposts at 12/25 mm offset; EPS/latex-bladder molding; 100/142 mm axle spacing; 160 mm maximum rotors. Accessory description supports headset, T47 BB choice, seatpost rail clamps and stem adapter. No measured full-package mass is given. Regional offers may differ in hanger count; no count is asserted.
